Campfire × Replit × J.P. Morgan Finance Hack Lab — 1st Hackathon Win

2026

First hackathon win after 13 attempts in the city, in the Innovative Theme & Solution category. Built an agent that, when a user searches for something to buy, surfaces sponsored ads in a way that shares value back with the user—Campfire's software handling the accounting. The idea grew out of my post on how AI agents will reshape advertising. Read the blog. Huge thanks to Lauren Elizabeth Quiring, Simar Kalkat, Chris Cheasty, Isabella Garbacz, Alina Libowitz Ehrlich & team for putting it together and giving me a stage to present.
